behavioral_signatures: Package installation triggers download of binaries from external S3 buckets
Binaries executed during build or install phase access credentials or sensitive files
Unexpected outbound network connections during package installation
file_indicators: Binaries downloaded from non-official or hijacked S3 buckets
Presence of unexpected native binaries in node_modules/bignum/bin/
network_indicators: Connections to unknown or recently registered S3 buckets
Outbound traffic to S3 endpoints not associated with the legitimate package author
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor package installation processes for downloads from external S3 buckets, especially for packages that do not typically require native binaries. Analyze executed binaries for credential or system information access, and flag any outbound network connections to unrecognized S3 buckets during or immediately after installation. Alert on any package that accesses sensitive files or environment variables during build or install time.
